identifiability_analysis.justification: Under scientific epistemology, attributing failure exclusively to 'model capacity' requires a controlled scaling ablation (e.g. keeping data, objective, and training steps constant while increasing d_model or layers to 7M, 15M, etc.). Because no scaled ChakrMicro models were trained in this mission, capacity limitations and optimization/loss formulation limitations are mathematically confounded. Specifically: 300 optimizer steps (totaling ~127k SFT tokens seen) represents less than 1 epoch over the 12,000 dataset (which contains ~414k tokens). Therefore, under-fitting due to an ultra-short training schedule cannot be disentangled from parameter capacity.

competing_hypotheses.reasoning: 192 dimensions is compact, but models of this size can memorize or condition on narrow synthetic subsets.
The pilot only executed 300 steps. The model only observed ~3,600 SFT examples out of 12,000. It had insufficient gradient exposure to rotate weights.
Decoupled objective preserved pretraining (loss=3.96), but simultaneously locked the model into pretraining representations.
